channel.title: Swansea Labour news
channel.description: Stories from Swansea Labour, for the Swansea Labour Councillors Facebook page

item.title: Labour council starts Killay flood scheme: what the traffic changes mean
item.description:
Swansea's Labour council is moving ahead with its major scheme to protect Killay from flooding. Traffic around Killay Square changes from Monday 16 November.
#Killay #Dunvant #Flooding #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour's Copr Bay North car park open as new screens promote Swansea events
item.description:
Swansea's Labour council says the Copr Bay North car park is open, its new digital screens are promoting city events, and talks with retailers for the units below are going well.
#Castle #CityCentre #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour council brings Pension Credit help to Gorseinon with free drop-in session
item.description:
Swansea's Labour council is helping older residents in Gorseinon check if they can claim Pension Credit, at a drop-in session on 19 November.
#Gorseinon #Penyrheol #CostOfLiving #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour invites residents to see progress on new-look Castle Square Gardens
item.description:
Swansea's Labour council is inviting residents to meet the Castle Square Gardens project team and contractors Knights Brown at Y Storfa on 26 November.
#Castle #CityCentre #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour council to host new team for North Gate Swansea's £20m Pride in Place programme
item.description:
Three new staff will help turn community ideas into action in North Gate Swansea's £20 million Pride in Place programme. Swansea's Labour council will host the team.
#Castle #Regeneration #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour council gives Victoria Road in Waunarlwydd a full resurfacing
item.description:
Swansea's Labour council is completing a full resurfacing of Victoria Road in Waunarlwydd, with an evening closure on Friday night from 6pm to midnight.
#Waunarlwydd #Roads #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour councillors bring Morriston's Christmas parade and lights switch-on back
item.description:
Morriston's Christmas parade and lights switch-on returns on Friday 27 November from 5pm, organised and funded by the ward's Labour councillors.
#Morriston #Christmas #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour takes new 350-place special school a major step forward
item.description:
Swansea's Labour council has submitted a full planning application for a new Ysgol Calon Lân, a purpose-built special school for up to 350 learners with 100 extra places.
#Mynyddbach #Schools #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour congratulates Ysgol Gymraeg Tan-y-lan on gold careers award
item.description:
Swansea's Labour council has congratulated Ysgol Gymraeg Tan-y-lan on winning the Gold Award at the Careers Wales Quality Awards, with Ysgol Uwchradd Bryntawe taking Silver.
#Mynyddbach #Penderry #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour council opens online evening for anyone thinking of fostering
item.description:
Swansea's Labour council is making it easier to find out about fostering, with a Foster Wales Swansea online information session on Thursday 19 November, 6pm to 7pm.
#Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour council's sold-out fireworks spectacular charms thousands at Singleton Park
item.description:
Thousands packed Singleton Park for a sold-out myths and magic fireworks night put on by Swansea's Labour council, the show's first year at its new home.
#Sketty #WhatsOn #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour council closes two more illegal vape shops in Swansea
item.description:
Swansea's Labour council has shut two more St Helen's Road shops caught selling illegal vapes and counterfeit tobacco, taking the total closed since June to 14.
#Castle #TradingStandards #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour council's £40,000 boost for 23 Men's Sheds across Swansea
item.description:
Swansea's Labour council has awarded £40,000 to 23 Sheds across the city, helping people connect, learn new skills and beat loneliness. It takes Labour's investment in Men's Sheds to £175,000 over seven years.
#Llansamlet #Regeneration #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour council replaces Uplands traffic lights as part of £14m roads investment
item.description:
Swansea's Labour council has started replacing the old traffic lights at the main Uplands junction, part of its £14 million investment in roads and highways for 2026/27. Temporary lights run from 9 November.
#Uplands #Roads #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour council's £76,000 green energy boost for rural Swansea groups
item.description:
Swansea's Labour council is giving five rural community organisations more than £76,000 for solar panels, batteries, heat pumps and EV chargers, cutting their energy bills for good.
#Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour council lands Becky Hill as first headliner for Tunes on the Bay 2027
item.description:
BRIT Award winner Becky Hill will headline Friday 30 April 2027 on Swansea Bay Beach as Labour's council brings Tunes on the Bay back for a third year.
#SwanseaBay #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour-backed Multibank brings Christmas toys to Swansea families
item.description:
A special delivery of toys from Amazon has arrived at Multibank Cymru, which Swansea's Labour council helped to found and funds every year, to reach local families before Christmas.
#Christmas #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour council moves to create 14 new nature reserves across Swansea
item.description:
Swansea's Labour council is bringing forward 14 new Local Nature Reserves, from Port Eynon's dunes to the Mumbles coast, creating the largest network of its kind in Wales.
#SwanseaBay #Swansea #SwanseaLabour #Nature #LocalNatureReserve

item.title: Labour council's free Spooks in the City draws thousands to Swansea city centre
item.description:
Thousands packed St David's Place on Halloween for Spooks in the City: Día de los Muertos, a free celebration of Mexican culture put on by Swansea's Labour council with ILA-Wales.
#Castle #CityCentre #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour council's storm drain upgrade to protect Killay from flooding
item.description:
Swansea's Labour council is installing an overflow drainage system at Killay Square to stop the junction flooding in heavy rain. Work starts on November 16.
#Killay #Dunvant #Flooding #Swansea #SwanseaLabour
